title: Specify delegated authority the way an office works
description:
**Phase 6 of 7.** The design risk of the whole initiative lives in this phase. Do it against a running multi-member organization, not in the abstract.

- **Blocked by:** 6c1a9b, 0814e6, ddf609
- **Runs in parallel with:** nothing. It gates the rest of the epic
- **Unblocks:** eef4aa

---
Gherkin first: a member approves within their ceiling and is refused outside it; a member cannot write an always-allow rule broader than their own standing; a delegation expires; an action exceeding the requester's ceiling escalates to a member whose ceiling covers it.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Starting: blockers 6c1a9b/0814e6/ddf609 closed (Phase 5 deployed). Dispatching Composer 2.5 to write the Gherkin scenarios (member approves within ceiling + refused outside; cannot write always-allow broader than own standing; delegation expires; action exceeding ceiling escalates to a member whose ceiling covers it) against the running org model, so they exist and fail for the right reason. Pure spec, no implementation.

comments.author: home
comments.text: summary: Specified in PR #175 (squash-merged to develop). features/delegated_authority.feature with 8 @wip scenarios — (1) member approves within ceiling, (2) refused outside ceiling, (3) writes always-allow within standing, (4) refused always-allow broader than standing, (5) active delegation authorizes, (6) expired delegation refuses, (7) exceeding ceiling escalates to covering member, (8) no member covers -> stays blocked. Steps raise StepNotImplementedError -> 18 pending_warn (exit 0). Gates: black, ruff, pytest (470), behave (310 scenarios + 18 pending_warn); PR #175 CI green. Done-when met: scenarios exist and fail for the right reason. Closing. Unblocks eef4aa.
